mainEntity.name: Is Swedish massage the same as relaxation massage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swedish is a common style used for relaxation. It typically features broad, flowing strokes, with pressure adapted to the client.
It should not require pain. Tell your therapist if the pressure is too strong, too light, or different from what you prefer. The session can be adjusted.

mainEntity.name: Will I have to remove all my clothes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can undress to your comfort level. Professional draping is used for your privacy, and you can discuss any concerns before the session begins.

mainEntity.name: Can I request focus on my neck or back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell your therapist where you would like extra attention, and the session can be adjusted within the service you booked.

mainEntity.name: How is it different from deep tissue massage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swedish massage usually emphasizes longer, flowing movements and relaxation. Deep tissue uses slower, more focused work. Techniques can overlap depending on your goals. Explore deep tissue massage.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to add aromatherapy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Enhancements are optional and their availability varies. Check the current booking menu and tell us about any sensitivities or preferences.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost, and how do I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current prices, appointment lengths, and availability are displayed in our online booking menu. Choose an appointment or text 262-939-9325 for help.
